title: Gilneas: Exile and Return
summary: The worgen curse, Forsaken invasion, years of exile, and later reclamation form a long story of home and identity.
opening: Gilneas was lost amid a curse and invasion. Its people carried both wounds into exile before a later generation could speak of return.
reviewNote: Review the original Gilneas starting experience and released reclamation quests for leadership and exact outcome.
